# Security and privacy reports

Please report exposed personal information, credentials, or exploitable code privately through [Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/0k-lab/crypto-card-for-ukraine-research/security/advisories/new).

Include the affected file or page, a short description, and steps to reproduce when relevant. Do not post unredacted screenshots, wallet addresses, card details, or credentials in public issues. Share only the minimum information needed to identify the problem.

Security fixes target the current `main` branch. Older snapshots and forks are not maintained separately.

For public corrections to fees, calculations, or wording, use a regular issue or pull request with public or redacted evidence.
